propositions: The Pass-4 gate coaches authors via 15 registered moves, but the plan-writing guide never names any move, leaving coached authors without a place to look up the technique.

A 'Responding to coaching moves' section should be added to writing-a-passing-plan.md documenting the top five moves in field-frequency order, each with a technique description and before/after example.
The [operator-attested] tag associated with state-attestation-evidence must be documented in the guide.
Move names in the guide must match the MOVE_REGISTRY spellings exactly, verified by a unit test importing coach_moves.py.
A generated per-move reference (rebar explain <move>) was rejected as too much machinery for content that fits one guide section.
